notes: EnclosureSurface for Processor<S, Matrix4> in vendor/truck/truck-evidence/src/decorators/processor.rs. enclose resolves the orientation swap once ((au,av) = (vv,uu) when inverted) and maps the inner box through the homogeneous interval transform (rows 1..4 of T*(x y z 1) via the field accessors of the column-major matrix, divided by the w row; w containing 0 or empty returns Interval::ENTIRE on all three axes, a fallback unreachable for the affine bottom row). enclose_der swaps orders and arguments together, returns enclose for (0,0) (the crate's convention, mirroring der_mn(0,0) = subs.to_vec()), and applies only the linear part for every other order, mirroring transform_vector exactly -- for a non-affine bottom row truck's der_mn is not the derivative of truck's subs, and the trait's contract is to enclose der_mn, so the carrier is mirrored. normal_cone and immersion_lower_bound share the private cross_box helper (enclose_der(1,0) x enclose_der(0,1)); immersion_lower_bound is sqrt(mig^2+mig^2+mig^2) computed in inari with .inf() returned (rounding unit too large would be a soundness bug), 0.0 on empty/non-finite. normal_cone uses rho=||h||.sup() and cn=||c||.inf() via the same interval norm helper; None exactly when rho >= cn (box contains zero or straddles too many directions), otherwise axis=c.normalize() and half_angle = asin(rho/cn) nudged up by (1+8eps)*x+8eps and clamped to the named MAX_HALF_ANGLE (pi). Test matrix uses translation + rotation (non-uniform axis) + non-uniform scale in every test. The normal-cone test keeps its sphere patch small: under the non-uniform scale the sound-but-loose cross box of a wider patch can honestly return None (the contract arm), and the test asserts the sampled-normals containment on the box where a cone is returned, the two orientations' axes oppose (normal reversal falls out of the parameter swap, not a manual sign flip), and None for a full 2pi transformed-cylinder sweep. Impl bound is exactly S: EnclosureSurface<Vector = Vector3>; the compiler asked for nothing more. All six mandated tests added (assert_encloses_surface at 21 samples/axis); every comparison epsilon carries a same-line // H-3 comment (only one 1e-N literal on the diff, in cone_contains, annotated). cargo fmt --check -p truck-evidence, cargo clippy -p truck-evidence --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings, cargo test -p truck-evidence --lib --tests --no-fail-fast (59 lib + 3 integration, all pass, existing tests unchanged), and cargo check --workspace --all-targets all pass. kernel-gates.sh exits 0 (baseline integration/kernel-bg).
